title: Applied ML experiment scratchpad - 2026-03-14
content:
Goal: quick record of today's eval runs, prompt set experiments, quantization notes, and immediate TODOs. Mostly notes to self - rough, may copy to PR/Confluence later.

Context:
- trying 4-bit q4_0 vs q4_K_M on rw-model-3b-v1 under serving runtime branch perf/kv-cache-opt. Want to measure LM perplexity on our eval set and end-user instruction fidelity.
- short latency budget (p50 <= 45ms for 32-token responses at 1 concurrent request).

Runs summary (local infra, single A100):
1) baseline fp16 (rw-3b-v1): perf ok, p50 38ms, perplexity 12.1, instr-fidelity 0.82 (manual eval on 100 prompts).
2) q4_0 -> p50 29ms, perplexity 13.8, instr-fidelity 0.78. Memory ok, but hallucination rate up ~+5%.
3) q4_K_M -> p50 31ms, perplexity 12.9, instr-fidelity 0.81. Slightly better than q4_0 on fidelity.
4) q8_0 (for baseline cost comp) -> p50 33ms, perplexity 12.5, fidelity 0.815.
Notes: q4_K_M seems reasonable tradeoff for our prompts (few-shot + code). For instruction-only prompts q4_0 sometimes ok but more off-by-one errors.

Prompt sets tried (short labels):
- P1-instr: 100 instruction-following prompts (open-ended).
- P2-code: 60 code-gen prompts (python, small functions).
- P3-summarize: 80 summarization prompts (long input -> short).
- P4-chat: multi-turn chat slices (dialog style).

Quick metrics (subset, 50-sample runs):
- P1-instr: fp16 fidelity 0.86 | q4_0 0.79 | q4_K_M 0.84
- P2-code: fp16 fidelity 0.88 | q4_0 0.80 | q4_K_M 0.87 (q4_K_M preserves identifiers better)
- P3-summarize: small degradation with q4_0 (ROUGE drop ~1.8), q4_K_M ~0.7 drop

Observed failure modes (samples saved to /tmp/ashascratch/q4-fails-2026-03-14.jsonl):
- dropped tokens in code blocks (q4_0) -> break unit tests
- numeric hallucinations in instruction answers (q4_0)
- occasional slower init on cold KV cache due to quant kernel warmup (add to perf checklist)

Hypotheses to test next:
- A) different chunking for KV cache when using q4 kernels improves code fidelity (reduce prefix truncation).
- B) mixed precision hybrid: keep attention/FF in q8, weights in q4_K_M -> try via quant config file.
- C) rerun P2-code with deterministic seed+beam search to isolate token-level diffs.

Immediate TODOs (priority):
- [ ] Push small experiment branch perf/q4-km-hybrid (start template based on PR#898). Deadline: 2026-03-16.
- [ ] Add 200 more code prompts to P2 (cover loops, recursion, edge cases). Owner: me.
- [ ] Create short eval slice for CI: 20 critical prompts (code+instr) to run on every model-quant combo. Discuss with Jordan.
- [ ] Add metric for 'identifier-preservation' (heuristic: percentage of identifier tokens preserved in output). Quick prototype in eval harness.
- [ ] Log long tail fails into S3 bucket redwood-inference-analyses/q4-fails/ (s3:// path TODO)

Notes to self: keep both q4_0 and q4_K_M as presets in optimize suggestions page. We surface tradeoffs: latency vs fidelity per workload. For Dedicated customers, recommend q4_K_M for code-heavy workloads unless ultra-low cost required.

Scratch reminders (small):
- ping Liam about A100 reservation on 3/16 morning (need 4 hours).
- capture a few representative fail cases and add to Confluence page (CON-3481) before demo.

End of scratchpad.
summary: Scratchpad for eval runs comparing q4_0 and q4_K_M quant configs, prompt sets P1-P4, failure modes, hypotheses and TODOs.
